visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-top hero; the Style option picks the treatment
visualCharacteristics.description: home: full-bleed background image, blue tint, centered white heading/text/CTAs. left: same as home but left-aligned text, CTA optional. banner: solid blue, centered text. plain: white, dark left text. gradient: indigo-to-teal banner with image bleeding right. split / split-left: text and image side by side. promo: contained ~250px promotional banner, cover background photo with a transparent-to-dark bottom gradient, centred white light heading (56px desktop), 16px subtitle, red 8px-radius primary button.

contentPattern.structure: optional image row (image + alt) and a rich text row (heading, subtitle, optional CTA links)

options.label: Gradient (banner, white text, image bleeds right)

usage.description: Home, Products, About Us, Chemistry pages; Host Response to Infection solution page header (left). Advanced Informatics product page promotional banner (promo).

reuseGuidance: Use left for solution/landing page headers with a photo background and left-aligned title + subtitle; use home when text should be centered with CTAs.
